title: Pass 3 reference table — Mitchison (1980) canalization on a growing (cell-dividing) hexagonal leaf lamina
note: Parameters are the solver's own (dimensionless, one cell's auxin production per unit time = sigma0); reference values are literature-derived where a source is given and are otherwise explicitly marked as model-internal checks. Nothing here is a digitised figure value of Mitchison (1980).

reference_benchmarks.name: sink_intake_over_production_steady_state
reference_benchmarks.source: Mass balance of Mitchison (1980) Eq. 2 at steady state with mu -> 0 (model-internal check)

reference_benchmarks.name: nesting_fraction_new_strands_in_old_panels
reference_benchmarks.source: Scarpella, Marcos, Friml & Berleth (2006) Genes Dev. 20:1015-1027, doi:10.1101/gad.1402406; Kang & Dengler (2004) Int. J. Plant Sci. 165:231-242, doi:10.1086/382794 — higher-order veins arise inside areoles bounded by lower-order veins

reference_benchmarks.name: betti_1_loops_reversible_canalization
reference_benchmarks.source: Potential-flow argument (every closed loop contains a flux divide); Feugier & Iwasa (2006) J. Theor. Biol. 243:235-244, doi:10.1016/j.jtbi.2006.05.022 — canalization alone does not close loops

reference_benchmarks.name: specimen_vein_areal_coverage_fraction
reference_benchmarks.source: segment_leaf_venation_specimen() vein_coverage_fraction on the pinned specimen (includes vein-mask dilation; an upper bound on true vein area fraction)

reference_benchmarks.name: specimen_secondary_vein_angle_deg
reference_benchmarks.source: segment_leaf_venation_specimen() structure-tensor orientation (Pass 2); Rolland-Lagan & Prusinkiewicz (2005) Plant J. 44:854-865

reference_benchmarks.name: vein_to_parenchyma_concentration_ratio
reference_benchmarks.source: Mitchison (1980) Fig. 2 qualitative ordering S_vein < S_par; the numeric 0.31 is the Pass 2 prescribed value, not a digitised datum

reference_benchmarks.name: sachs_bypass_sink_recovery_fraction
reference_benchmarks.source: Sachs (1981) Adv. Bot. Res. 9:151-262 — vascular continuity is restored around a transverse incision (qualitative); numeric value carried from the Pass 1-2 reference JSON

known_limitations: Hexagonal cellular lattice, not a finite-element mesh; growth is isotropic 2x refinement, not a measured leaf growth field

Facilitated diffusion (Mitchison 1980), not polar PIN1 carrier allocation (Mitchison 1981 / Feugier et al. 2005); the polar prototype produced circulating vortices on the square lattice and was not shipped
No loop closure: beta_1 = 0 for the reversible solver and for the irreversible-differentiation ablation, so quaternary areole subdivision is not reproduced
Strand orientations are quantised by the lattice (~30/60/90 deg), so the branch-angle comparison with the specimen (52.9 deg) is lattice-limited
Hop-count path tortuosity on the hex lattice is insensitive to lateral deflection (diagonal hops advance sqrt(3)/2 in y), so L_wounded/L_intact ~ 1.0 even with a 6-cell bypass
